video.name: 航海王 女英雄们的故事
video.intro: After buying a pair of shoes that end up hurting her feet, Nami returns to the shop feeling dissatisfied. There, she meets Lebno, the designer, who tells her, "I'll make you a brand-new pair from scratch—but only if you’ll be my model." The shoes are crafted by the artisan Miucha, leading to an unexpected and stylish encounter.
